title: Unicorn World full headwear and accessory coverage

path_roots.base_file: relative to its parent unicorn_full_wardrobe directory

global_slot_order: accessory near with occlusion baked into transparency
slot_contract: Choose one head item, one body item and ONE accessory item. Do not combine multiple accessories in the same slot. Apply frame-matched transforms and whole-group mirroring about pivot_stage.
local_order_note: Per-record z_order describes the local item stack. Accessory masks are baked into transparency; never draw accessory source_foreground_reference over body clothing. The body worker contract may add frame-specific vehicle foreground at its correct depth.
